purpose: Predeclare a bounded perturbation-stability study before any robustness claim is considered.

perturbations.description: Reduce normalized display intensity by 5% with clipping.
Increase normalized display intensity by 5% with clipping.
Reduce contrast around the normalized midpoint by 5% with clipping.
Increase contrast around the normalized midpoint by 5% with clipping.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not convert this protocol into a validated OOD detector.
Do not interpret brightness or contrast perturbations as scanner/institutional shift validation.
Do not create an aggregate robustness or clinical-safety score from these descriptive outputs.
Do not promote the protocol to release evidence until the exact evaluation dataset, sample-selection rule, transformations, software version, and results are recorded reproducibly.
